subject: Film & Cinema
title: Slow Cinema: The Art of Patience
description: A micro-lesson that makes Slow Cinema: The Art of Patience usable.

hook.text: A seven-minute shot of a man walking. No dialogue. No music. Some call it genius.

buildup.text: Slow cinema uses long takes, minimal action, and silence to force deep observation.

discovery.text: Directors like Tarr, Tsai, and Weerasethakul create films that demand a different kind of viewing.

twist.text: In an era of short attention spans, slow cinema is both a rebellion and a test of patience.

climax.text: For those willing to surrender, slow cinema offers meditative experiences unlike anything else.

punchline.text: The slowest films see the most.

quiz.question: What is the defining feature of slow cinema?
options: Long takes, minimal action, and contemplative pacing
